# ProShotClock

> ProShotClock is a free online basketball shot clock that runs in any web browser, with no download or sign-up. It supports the 24-second NBA/WNBA/FIBA clock, the 30-second NCAA college clock, the 35-second U.S. high school (NFHS) clock, and the 12-second FIBA 3x3 (3v3) clock, plus 14- and 20-second resets, custom timers, an end-of-clock buzzer, customizable keyboard shortcuts, and an external full-screen display for a second monitor or projector. It also offers a "YouTube Free Play" mode for practising shot-clock operation over any basketball video, and is localized into 10 languages.

## Key facts about basketball shot clocks
- NBA, WNBA and FIBA: 24-second shot clock; resets to 14 seconds after an offensive rebound (or certain defensive fouls/violations) when the offense keeps possession in the frontcourt.
- NCAA men's and women's college basketball: 30-second shot clock; resets to 20 seconds after an offensive rebound in the frontcourt (since 2018-19 for men, 2017-18 for women).
- U.S. high school (NFHS): optional 35-second shot clock that each state association may adopt, beginning with the 2022-23 season; adoption varies by state.
- FIBA 3x3 (3v3, half-court, Olympic since Tokyo 2020): 12-second shot clock — half of the 24-second 5-on-5 clock; there is no separate partial reset (no 14-second equivalent), a new possession simply gets a fresh 12 seconds.
- A shot clock limits how long the offense may hold the ball before a shot hits the rim; expiry is a shot-clock violation. The NBA introduced it in 1954.

## Pages
- [Shot clock app and guide](https://proshotclock.com/): the interactive timer plus shot-clock rules, a league comparison table, a how-to, and an FAQ.
- [Shot clock over YouTube (Free Play)](https://proshotclock.com/youtube/): load any YouTube basketball game and operate a corner-overlay 24-second shot clock over the footage in real time, using the keyboard.
- [30-second shot clock](https://proshotclock.com/30-second-shot-clock/): NCAA college clock, pre-set to 30 seconds with the 20-second reset.
- [3x3 shot clock](https://proshotclock.com/3x3-shot-clock/): FIBA 3x3 clock, pre-set to 12 seconds.
- [Embed the shot clock](https://proshotclock.com/embed/): copy one line of HTML to embed the clock on any website.
- [Whole-seconds display](https://proshotclock.com/?decimals=off): the main clock with final-seconds tenths turned off.

## About
- Author: Niccolò Bevacqua
- Cost: free (no sign-up, no download)
- Use cases: basketball practice, team drills, scrimmages, pickup games, referee/table-official training, and as a backup game clock.
